sources.citation: Talbot, P. Amaury. 1912. In the shadow of the bush. London: William Heinemann. xiv+500 pp. (archive.org inshadowofbush00perc)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. p.256 identifies 'Ekuri' as the exonym of the people who call themselves 'Nkokolle'; Appendix F pp.424ff 'Vocabularies of the six tribes in the Oban District' has an Ekuri (= Nkukoli) column in a bare, untoned English/Ekoi/Kwa/Efik/Ekuri/Ododop/Uyanga wordlist; the Appendix D tone remark concerns Ekoi. This is Glottolog's Glottolog's most extensive description for the language (a wordlist or less).
